pins.definition: The space above the earth where the sun, moon, clouds, and stars appear.
The space above the earth that you see when you look up, where the sun, clouds, and stars are.

situation: A young woman stands on a hilltop with her head tilted straight back, looking at the immense expanse above her.
subject: the vast space above the earth
brief: A lone woman stands on a grassy summit, her head thrown back in pure wonder as she gazes up into a vast, deep blue expanse that fills the upper two-thirds of the frame. Soft white clouds drift across the upper atmosphere, establishing the immense height and openness of the space above the ground.
